name: The Grand Illusion
flavor: Every eye in the tent turns to you at once. What they see next, they will never fully stop seeing.
components: Prop (a folding fan or opera mask)
description: You spend a surge of banked Phantasm to seize the minds of every creature you choose within a 30-foot-radius sphere centred on a point within range, showing each of them their own private, tailored nightmare all at once. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure, a target takes [[5d6]] psychic damage and is frightened of you for the duration; on a success, it takes half as much damage and is not frightened. **The damage happens once, as you cast it — this trick never deals damage again on a later turn.** What lasts for the duration is the fear: a frightened target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. It requires at least 4 Phantasm banked, spent whether or not any target fails its save.
narration: Every eye in the tent turns to you at once, and what they see next they will never fully stop seeing.
